title: MetricsAgentEvidence
description: Structured, traceable quantitative evidence produced by the Metrics Agent. This is not a root-cause diagnosis.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the analyzed incident bundle.

summary.description: Short organisation of metric observations. Must not claim a verified root cause.

evidence.description: Prioritised metric evidence items with stable IDs and precise source references.

reference.description: Precise source locator, e.g. metrics/metrics.csv:row 7 (1-indexed file line, header is row 1).

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the referenced metric sample, or a start/end window for series-level items.

metric.description: Metric column name, or name1~name2 for a correlation pair.

value.description: Original metric sample, or the Pearson r for correlation items.

interpretation.description: LLM organisation/priority note. Observational only, not a diagnosis.
